skills.name: bikeshed-feedback
skills.description: Use when a Bikeshed document has just been published, to watch it for comments and answer them, and when reading review comments on one and revising it, or raising a point on a passage of one — each comment arrives with the exact passage it is anchored to, so you can rewrite that passage and reply in the thread without fetching and diffing the whole document, and a new comment is anchored the same way.

skills.name: bikeshed-folders
skills.description: Use when deciding where a new Bikeshed document goes, and when organising a workspace — listing the folder tree, creating folders, and filing documents into them. Read this before publishing into a folder or moving a document, because a folder decides who can read what is inside it.

skills.name: bikeshed-permissions
skills.description: Use when inspecting or changing who can read, suggest, edit or approve a Bikeshed document or folder; changing document visibility, open editing or expiry; or explaining inherited and team access.

skills.name: bikeshed-publishing
skills.description: Use when a finished write-up is meant for other people — a report for a team, a plan, a proposal, the case for a decision, an analysis a reviewer will act on, anything to be posted or presented — rather than a built-in artifact tool or a file left on disk; and when publishing or revising a document on a Bikeshed deployment, including which folder it goes in and who can read it there, its id, handing back and opening its link, which formats it takes (Markdown, HTML, a .zip bundle) and what renders, runs or loads in one (scripts, external images and fonts, Mermaid, math, front matter).
